subject: declared capabilities, their bound exits, and the highest arrival each one's receipts support

arrival_levels.DECLARED: the bytes exist and a validator or gate can see them; possibility only
arrival_levels.EXERCISED: a fixture, selftest, or test ran it on synthetic input; sandbox arrival
arrival_levels.PRODUCTION: a session, cycle, or cadence receipt from a real run names it

append_rule: a row without at least one receipt carrying a resolvable ref is refused at append (TOPOLOGY_ROW_WITHOUT_RECEIPT). There are no aspirational rows: an unreceipted intention belongs on an issue, not in this ledger.
arrival_rule: the arrival column is derived, not remembered: it must equal the highest level this row's own receipts support. Above reds CLAIM_ABOVE_ARRIVAL, below reds CLAIM_BELOW_ARRIVAL. A ledger whose rows only move when an author remembers them is the stale list this one exists to kill.

evidence_claims.five-surface-audit: an audit that reads one surface answers declaration, not arrival: the driver enumerates imports, value_flow, ci, adapter and cli_text and reports the surface set
evidence_claims.consumer-less-core: offline-provable cores and __main__ probe scripts with zero consumers on any of the five surfaces, found by hand in one dispatcher session
evidence_claims.planned-island: a verb a consumer may remember to call, and a retrieval slice with no consumer surface at all, are islands being planned rather than found
evidence_claims.shared-exit-cure: the canonical cure: bind the capability to an exit the consumer already traverses and make the consumer's receipt inadmissible without it
evidence_claims.arrival-ledger: per-capability record of the highest arrival an actual receipt supports; a claim above the recorded level is a finding, and levels rise only by receipt readback
evidence_claims.cadence-run-denominator: the cadence sweep's first live run named checks=15, which is the five bundles admitted before it; a sixth bundle admitted after that run has never been in one
evidence_claims.false-documented-pin: a module header claiming its tool pins are mirrored in a lock file whose live bytes carry no such entries
evidence_claims.dangling-pointer: cross-repo interface pointers naming probe interfaces whose carrier has been adjudicated retired upstream, with nothing in the pointing repository re-reading them
evidence_claims.retired-carrier: the upstream retirement adjudication that makes every row pointing at that carrier a maintain-on-event trigger
evidence_claims.closure-by-pointer: findings terminate in a durable home some process re-reads; the closure law itself is pointed at in its owner, never restated here
